questions.question: How much longer is your stopping distance on a wet road?
questions.explanation: Tyres have less grip on wet roads, so stopping distances at least double.

questions.question: What should you do if your steering feels light in standing water?
options: Ease off the accelerator and slow down gradually
Speed up to clear the puddle
questions.explanation: Light steering means aquaplaning; ease off the gas gently until tyres grip again.
